model.slowModel: Expected-R V1 using frozen N250 aggregate evidence
model.rule: The update formula is frozen now. Future observations may change estimates only through this fixed formula; weights and buckets cannot be retuned before N500.

primaryQuestion: Can a fixed two-timescale Expected-R rule adapt to regime changes better than static Hunter score while remaining stable out of sample?
primaryMetrics: mean realized R of top-ranked shadow candidate
lift versus current Hunter ordering on matched candidate sets
lift versus frozen Expected-R V1 ordering
rank correlation between predicted Expected-R and realized R
maximum drawdown of the shadow-selected sequence

promotionGate.confidenceRequirement: 90% lower confidence bound above 0 when estimable
promotionGate.diversificationRequirement: No single side/timeframe/symbol or short streak may explain the result

forbiddenBeforeN500: retuning V2 weights or buckets using post-N250 outcomes
promoting a static BUY/SELL/timeframe hard filter from subgroup noise
note: This protocol was registered after the N250 checkpoint and before the N250->N500 evaluation is complete. It is research only and has no live execution authority.
